meta headline: Qoodish - Every Story Begins With a Map
meta description: Every map on Qoodish began as someone's journey. Carry one with you, and weave a story of your own.
internal server error: An internal server error has occurred
create map together: Put your journey on the map.
tell friends spot: The café you keep coming back to, the view you stumbled on, the trip that didn't go to plan. Leave them on the map, in your own words.
find your best place: A map is the start of an unexpected journey.
surely your friends know: A map of film and anime locations, a food-crawl map through an old shopping street, a map for wandering your own neighborhood. Pick up a map someone left behind, and you're already on your way. Bookmark the ones that catch your eye, and head out.

change email sent description: Click the link in the email to confirm your new email address. The link will expire in 60 minutes.
